blocking_issues.location: section 'The modern growth model is unusually concentrated in high technology' / 'O modelo moderno de crescimento é excepcionalmente concentrado em alta tecnologia'
blocking_issues.issue: The bar chart titled 'Israel: concentration of the 2025 high-tech economy' places employment share (11.4%), export share (58%) and high-tech output growth (8.2%) on one percent axis. These are dimensionally different measures: two are composition shares with different denominators and one is a growth rate. RESEARCH-VISUALS.md explicitly blocks comparing quantities with incompatible definitions merely because they share the same displayed unit.
blocking_issues.evidence: Reviewed EN and PT-BR sources contain the same three values in the same bar chart. The underlying prose can state all three facts, but a single common-axis bar comparison visually implies comparability that the evidence does not support.

required_fixes: Replace the incompatible high-tech bar chart in both EN and PT-BR with an evidence-bearing visual that does not place employment share, export share and output growth on one common quantitative axis. Valid options include separating growth from composition, using a table with explicit denominator/status columns, or charting only genuinely comparable observations.
Preserve exact EN/PT-BR visual parity after the correction and re-check every quantitative visual for compatible units, denominators and periods.
Return the same ID and slug with changed source SHAs; do not create a new logical publication identity.
evidence: Israel Innovation Authority's 2026 annual high-tech report supports the underlying 2025 values: NIS 352 billion high-tech GDP, 8.2% real growth, approximately 400,000 workers / 11.4% of employment, and approximately USD 85 billion / 58% of total exports.
RESEARCH-VISUALS.md requires quantitative visuals to use unambiguous units and blocks comparisons of quantities with incompatible definitions merely because they fit on one axis.
COUNTRY-CONTEXT.md makes the visual-evidence floor blocking for country dossiers dated on or after 2026-09-18.
notes: Rejected before public materialization. Taxonomy and country-context identity were not the blocking issue in this pass.
